scripts.audit:all: echo === Auditing Root === && npm audit --audit-level=high || cmd /c exit 0 && echo === Auditing Backend === && cd backend && npm audit --audit-level=high || cmd /c exit 0 && echo === Auditing Frontend === && cd ../frontend && npm audit --audit-level=high || cmd /c exit 0
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')){fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true})}; fs.renameSync('frontend/dist', 'dist')"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
